subject.title: fix(tlon): stop monitor tracking state from growing forever

question: Should Tlon mention-free thread participation be limited to the 2,000 most recently accessed parent IDs?
rationale: The cap fixes process-lifetime growth but intentionally removes message-delivery eligibility from older threads, so code correctness alone cannot establish the intended product policy.

options.title: Accept the 2,000-entry LRU
options.body: Approve the access-refreshed window and require a fresh bot mention after an older thread is evicted.

options.title: Choose another bounded lifecycle
options.body: Keep the invite-generation repair but replace the fixed count with an owner-selected count or expiry policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the 2,000-entry LRU
recommendation.body: Approve the access-refreshed window and require a fresh bot mention after an older thread is evicted.

likelyOwner.reason: He is directly connected to review and co-authorship of the affected Tlon monitor behavior and is the strongest available owner for this policy choice.
